verdict.rationale: The pack contains no documented bulk or batch operation capability, such as batch API requests, bulk user updates, or mass actions across many items. Paginated user listing is a read operation. Apps Script automation is a developer building block for constructing such workflows, not the capability itself. Group-scoped policy enforcement and automatic provisioning sync are adjacent features, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
